Thaddeus Greene

A Hunted character identified by ISAC at the novel's climax as the masked Hunter who attacks Brenda Wells's cell.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

A source-specific Hunter identification — major spoilers

At Hunted's climax, ISAC identifies the masked attacker as Thaddeus Greene and marks his status classified. The archive records that as a source-specific identification rather than flattening the mystery of every Hunter into one answer. [1]
